name: Love Delivery
source:
22 years old, high school level GED, motorcycle deliveryman. That's you. One rainy day, you are hit by a car while on a delivery and meet Juhee. As a result of this encounter, you get a job working at Juhee's cafe. While working at the cafe, you meet a girl named "Latte" and she seems to be a very interesting person. Can you shed off your loser life and succeed in making a girlfriend?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1817940/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
22岁，高中同等学力，靠骑摩托送外卖谋生。这就是你。某个雨天，你在送餐途中被汽车撞倒，因此结识了珠熙。这场相遇，让你有机会到她的咖啡馆工作。在咖啡馆里，你又遇到了一位名叫“拿铁”的女孩，她似乎是个很有意思的人。你能否摆脱一事无成的生活，成功交到女朋友呢？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1817940/]Steam[/url]]
